Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Contemporary Modern Chandelier with 5 White Glass Light Shades - 26 x 26 x 40 Inches, Matte Black
Colors: Matte Black
Materials: Metal
This pendant light has 5 matte-black metal arms that curve upward. Each light is adorned with a flower-shaped white glass shade that faces upward, giving this light the appearance of a simple, classy chandelier. 26''W x 26''D x 40''H Matte-black metal with white glass shade 5 glass shades Bulb not included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
